title: CR-001: add optional metadata object to the short-link creation request

backward_compatibility.notes: Optional request field; absent metadata and an empty map canonicalize to the same idempotency signature (DEC-025), so v1.0 signatures stay valid.

rollout_or_migration.rollback_or_compensation: Rollback: abort the migration transaction. After release: compensate by a forward migration that ignores the column; the column is never dropped destructively without G-DESTR approval.
